verdict.rationale: The evidence documents OneDrive's REST API surface through Microsoft Graph, a CSDL metadata document, Graph Explorer and a versioning policy. None of it mentions an official client SDK or library for any language. A raw REST API and a machine-readable schema are developer building blocks, not official SDKs, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
